Name: Fsjdxqt's Dialogue Changes
Author: fsjdxql
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
基于 invatorzen的dialogue 模组，代码重置，内容基于3.7版本新增，自带中文，详情见下。
Based on the dialogue module of invatorzen, the code has been reset. The content is based on the new additions of version 3.7 and comes with Chinese translation. For details, please see below.
[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]只需解压mod文件，再放到Mods文件夹就好。[/color]
Just extract the mod file and then place it in the "Mods" folder.
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]去除了Portraits和Characters的修改，请单独安装人物美化MOD。推荐[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15764]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15764[/url]Remove the modifications for Portraits and Characters. Please install the Character Enhancement MOD separately. Recommend: https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15764[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]将NPC名字改为Token，现在你可以给男性NPC改名了。只需进入i18n文件夹，修改对应语言的JSON文件。Change the NPC name to "Token". Now you can rename the male NPC. Just enter the i18n folder and modify the corresponding language's JSON file.[/color][/*]
[*]Alex对话修改：介绍，Evelyn绿雨对话，George 不能和Alex捉迷藏，潘姆在结婚后会说莫尔纳家的小姑娘而不是小伙子，Alex肖像家具，Alex武器。Alex dialogue modification: Introduction, Evelyn Green Rain dialogue, George can't play hide-and-seek with Alex, Pam will refer to the girl from the Molner family instead of the boy after getting married, Alex's portrait furniture, Alex's weapons.[/*]
[*]Elliott对话修改：与Elliott结婚后Leah对话改变，Elliott 肖像家具 ， Elliott 武器。Elliott's dialogue modification: After marrying Elliott, Leah's dialogue was changed. Elliott's portrait furniture, Elliott's weapons.[/*]
[*]Harvey对话修改：Jodiy有氧课会用她，与Penny结婚后Penny对话改变，节日winter8洗头而不是给胡子打蜡，Harvey看电影反应，Sebastian看医生，Harvey肖像家具 ，Harvey武器。Harvey's dialogue modification: aerobic class ，Jodi will use her to call new number. After marrying Penny, Penny's dialogue changes. During the winter,  Harvey washes her hair instead of waxing her beard. Harvey's reaction to watching a movie, Sebastian goes to see a doctor, Harvey's portrait of furniture, Harvey's weapons.[/*]
[*]Sam对话修改：与Sam约会结婚Abigail对话，Sam看电影反应，Sam肖像家具，Sam武器。Sam's dialogue modification: Abigail's conversation about dating and getting married to Sam. Sam's reaction to watching a movie. Sam's portrait of furniture. Sam's weapons.[/*]
[*]Sebastian对话修改： 与 Sebastian 约会结婚Abigail对话， Sebastian 看电影反应， Sebastian 肖像家具， Sebastian 武器。Sebastian's dialogue modification: Meeting and getting married with Sebastian. Abigail's dialogue. Sebastian's reaction to watching a movie. Sebastian's portrait of furniture. Sebastian's weapons. [/*]
[*]Shane对话修改： Shane 看电影反应， Shane 肖像家具。 Shane's dialogue modification: Shane's reaction to the movie, Shane's portrait furniture.[/*]
[/list]对话修改都为包括但不限于，因为实在记不清了。The dialogue modifications are all inclusive but not limited to, I really can't remember all of them.
作者是中国人，所以英文对话可能错误较多。The author is Chinese, so there might be more errors in the English dialogue.
如果有问题，请告知我。If you have any questions, please feel free to contact me.
